observer.scope: Passive full-address CPU markers, POKEY timestamps and I-flag transitions between emulator microstates; no guest instructions/cycles added
observer.build_options: Same as toolchain/altirra-build.json, build/latency target AltirraBridgeServer
observer.resolution: I transitions sampled between CPU microstates, including RTI followed immediately by IRQ. 1/8 base-cycle timestamps at 8x; includes NMI/ROM/DMA elapsed time. Not a hardware worst-case guarantee.

report.scope: Four-task diagnostic TX pump under concurrent kernel work; no production driver or RX

masked.scope: CPU I=1 intervals during first SEROUT write through final byte completion
masked.resolution: Observed between emulator microstates, including RTI-to-immediate-IRQ transitions; 1/8 base-cycle timestamps. Includes NMI/ROM/DMA time, not a hardware worst-case guarantee.

bank_zero.accounting: Generated maps; full guards, near arena, table slack and retained legacy contexts; unchanged pools.

limits: Scope is the named cases in these reports; no eight-task serial or physical-hardware claim.
No RX/turnaround, worker-buffer or global interrupt-phase bound. The observed maximum I=1 interval exceeds one byte period; measured refill deadlines still pass.

capacity.heap_totals: Exact before/after equality asserted on target
capacity.signals: Each owner asserts its original allocation mask after deleting its port

timing_endpoints.client: Marker after reply removal and identity/type validation; includes finishing the current workload batch and shutting down workers before collection
